Already handled

It knows each post’s quirks

The things a first National Posts integration learns the hard way, written into the add-on so yours doesn’t have to.

01

Magyar Posta ships nothing until the day is closed

Close the day from the connection and the posting list is stored. After that MPL can’t void or reprint, so do both first.

02

Hrvatska pošta caps e-mail at 25 characters

A longer address is left off and the shipment warns — cutting an address short would make it wrong.

03

No home-made labels for Pošta Slovenije

Its API returns no label or tracking number, so the driver offers tracking and points only, never a label refused at the counter.

Honest about it

Confidence, stated per post

Nothing here has run against a live account. Hrvatska pošta and Magyar Posta are checked against their own documentation (high confidence); Pošta Slovenije is low–medium and ELTA low.

Check before going live

  • ELTA publishes no API documentation — verify before production
  • ELTA runs over plain HTTP on port 9003
  • Hrvatska pošta needs outbound ports 9000 and 9020
  • Pošta Slovenije’s tracking response structure is unpublished
Test every connection in each post’s test system — Magyar Posta’s is a mock, ELTA has a test account.

Posts

Needs Carrier, the gateway — $149, then $129 a year. It owns checkout pricing, the claim that stops a label being bought twice, printing, tracking and the point picker. Every add-on is free, and one licence drives all of them.

$ composer require justinholtweb/craft-carrier justinholtweb/craft-carrier-posts
$ php craft plugin/install carrier && php craft plugin/install carrier-posts
